rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or figure that embodies an idea, including a human representation such as the Grim Reaper.

example.english: They are practically the personification of courage.
example.jyutping: keoi5 gaan2 zik6 hai6 jung5 hei3 ge3 faa3 san1

rows.note: Use this for the literary or artistic technique of giving an object or idea human qualities, rather than for the resulting figure itself.

example.english: This poem uses personification to make the moon seem able to speak to people.
example.traditional: 呢首詩運用擬人法，令月亮好似識得同人講嘢咁。
